correctness.rationale: In char 3 the smooth elliptic base has Hasse invariant zero; branch divisor q=XY+sXZ+tZ² has a simple zero at infinity. The eliminated quintic F=x^5+x^3+(1-s²)x²+stx-t² has Res_x(F,F')=t²Delta, with t=0 handled separately. Exact coefficient expansion of (P Q)^2 in the Koszul monomial basis independently reproduces H=[[0,0,0,0],[0,s,-1,s+t],[0,0,0,1],[0,0,-1,s]], whose 3x3 block determinant is s and surviving 2x2 block invertible. One-step/stable rank yields f,a=(3,1) off s=0 and (2,2) on it, and Newton slopes follow from residual dimension ≤2. The boundary Delta(0,t)=-(t²+1)^3 gives two order-three contacts, with local w²=u³ cusps and genus-three normalizations. Distinct degree-six branch divisors modulo finite automorphisms establish two moduli dimensions.
residual_risks: Claims describe exactly this characteristic-three net and two boundary members, not all genus-four bielliptic curves or the global discriminant.
